UPDATE certificate
                SET names = $2, chain = $3, key_sealed = $4, sealed_by = $5, not_before = $6,
                    not_after = $7, state = $8, reason = $9, renew_after = $10, revision = $11,
                    attempts = $12, next_attempt_at = $13, issuing_until = NULL
              WHERE id = $1
